Karl Otto Paul Hansen, born in 1899, said to be at Hamburg, son of George Henrik Hansen and Christine.
He has not yet been found in the Hamburg birth or death indexes, or on any passenger list to New York,
so he probably stayed in Germany. He married Martha Stiefs of Varel.
Born at Varel, in Friesland near the Jade, on 17 November 1904, by the family's record.
The name is spelled Stiefs in the German records: it is a Varel and Bockhorn family,
and Stiefses farmed at Kranenkamp and Altjührden.
Her parents are remembered as Paul and Ida.
The Maksimow family lived at Varel and Bockhorn in their DP years after 1947.
Her 1904 entry in the Varel birth register would name her parents and settle the family.
